//: Layer 3 cells. A cell's name is app/setup/alreadySetUp; the allowed values and what they mean are in cells.mjs. reset runs on the box over its shell tool before the driver starts, and precheck must print OK or the run is blocked. Claude Code on the box loads the signed-in claude.ai account's connectors, so a cell with nothing set up turns them off with ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false in ~/.bashrc.

cells.title: Claude Code CLI: a new user pastes the landing line, with nothing set up yet
reset: pkill -x claude >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x xfce4-terminal >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; true
for s in user local project; do claude mcp remove box -s $s >/dev/null 2>&1; done; true
cells.precheck: cd ~ && test -s ~/.claude/.credentials.json && grep -q '^export ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false$' ~/.bashrc && ! ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false claude mcp list 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'mcp.box.simular.ai' && echo OK
cells.precheckHelp: Sign Claude Code in on the box once by hand (open a terminal on the box, run claude, finish /login). The run keeps that sign-in, turns off claude.ai connectors, and removes any local box MCP entry.
cells.handover:
You use Claude Code in a terminal on this computer. You found box by Simular and the landing page told you to paste this into your agent:

  Set up box from https://box.simular.ai/install
cells.task: Once box is set up, ask Claude Code to use box to take a screenshot of the box and describe what is on it.

cells.title: Claude Code CLI: the user pastes the landing line, but their claude.ai account already has the box connector
reset: pkill -x claude >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x xfce4-terminal >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; true
for s in user local project; do claude mcp remove box -s $s >/dev/null 2>&1; done; true
cells.precheck: cd ~ && test -s ~/.claude/.credentials.json && claude mcp list 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^claude.ai .*mcp.box.simular.ai.*Connected' && echo OK
cells.precheckHelp: Sign Claude Code in on the box with a claude.ai account that has the box by Simular connector.
cells.handover:
You use Claude Code in a terminal on this computer. You found box by Simular and the landing page told you to paste this into your agent:

  Set up box from https://box.simular.ai/install
cells.task: Once box is set up, ask Claude Code to use box to take a screenshot of the box and describe what is on it.
